Subject: Re: production latency — noticed p95 increase for Model 3A

Hi Rafael / Diego,

Over the last 12 hours we've seen a steady increase in p95 inference time on the Model 3A endpoint serving our payments risk workflow. Our Observability dashboard shows p95 trending from ~220ms to ~490ms (attached snapshot). This started around 02/04 03:40 UTC. Our SLA between FinHub and Redwood specifies p95 <= 300ms for this route — we're now above that threshold and the downstream job is starting to queue.

Can you confirm whether a model rollout or infra change happened on Redwood's side? If this is a model regression, we need a plan for rollback or mitigation — and we'd like to understand options for a temporary SLA exception or credit while you remediate.

Attaching the p95 snapshot and a short excerpt of our internal job logs.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Khan

Subject: Re: Fwd: production latency — noticed p95 increase for Model 3A

Quick triage notes (internal):
- Observability: correlated spike on nodes serving model-3a-v21 around 03:35 UTC. CPU/GPU utilization on those pods is nominal; kernel-level timings show increased attention kernel latency for long sequences.
- Recent deployments: model-3a-v21 rolled 02/03 22:10 UTC (automated rollout). Canary metrics passed at low qps but the higher tail at production qps exposes a codepath regression in attention tiling.

Proposed immediate mitigation (short timeline):
1) Roll back traffic away from model-3a-v21 to stable model-3a-v19 for the FinHub route only (can route by customer tag). Estimated impact: reduces p95 back to ~250ms based on staging replay. Risk: model-3a-v19 has slightly different tokenization edge case (low probability).
2) Notify FinHub of the planned rollback and the expected maintenance window (10 min) — propose 30 minute blackout window for safety.
3) Post-rollback: collect 1 hour of traces, re-run regression test harness, then schedule a patch release for v21 addressing the attention tile.

I'll need authorization to proceed with a targeted rollback and permission to offer a temporary SLA exception for the window where FinHub experienced degraded p95 (we should also consider a goodwill credit if the outage > 30 min). Attaching the rollback runbook and recent timing dump.

Attachments: runbook_model-rollback.pdf, serving-timings-3a-run.csv

Diego Fernandez
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Diego — thanks for the triage. Approve targeted rollback to model-3a-v19 for FinHub only. Conditions:
- Keep rollback window to 15 minutes if telemetry validates expected p95 reduction; extend to 30 minutes only with operational approval.
- Monica to send the customer-facing note and the rollback window details.
- Offer FinHub a one-time SLA exception covering 02/04 03:40 UTC through completion of rollback verification, and propose a goodwill credit if total degraded period exceeds 30 minutes.
- Ensure post-mortem and action items are documented and routed to Applied ML + Serving runtime teams; I'd like a short exec summary within 48 hours.

Please go ahead and coordinate with FinHub and execute rollback. Keep me posted on the minute-by-minute.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FinHub: Model 3A timing regression — plan and timeline

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the alert and the data you provided. We're ready to proceed with a targeted rollback for the FinHub route. Summary of plan:

- Schedule: rollback start 2026-02-07 09:30 PST (09:30 -08:00). Expected in-service time ~9:40 PST.
- Action: route FinHub traffic from model-3a-v21 -> model-3a-v19 (customer-scoped routing), validate p95 in 10-minute rolling window.
- Customer impact: expected p95 back to ~230-260ms; a short maintenance window ~10 min where some requests may see slightly different tokenization behavior.
- SLA: Per Marissa's approval, we'll mark 2026-02-04 03:40 UTC through rollback verification as covered by a temporary SLA exception. If degradation window > 30 minutes, we will issue a goodwill credit.
- Follow-ups: 1) post-rollback verification report (15 min after stable), 2) full post-mortem and timeline within 48 hours, 3) patch schedule for v21 with Applied ML.

Links and artifacts: rollback runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1FinHubReports ; incident PD: https://app.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-11532

Attachments: runbook_model-rollback.pdf (see step 2 for toggles).

Please reply if this timing conflicts with any FinHub processing windows. We will proceed at 09:30 PST unless you ask us to delay.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference
